```python
from seedemu import Emulator, Base, Routing, Ebgp, Ibgp, Ospf, WebService
from seedemu.layers import Layer
from seedemu.core import AutonomousSystem, NetworkType, PeerRelationship

# Create the emulator and layers
emu = Emulator()
base = Base()
routing = Routing()
ebgp = Ebgp()
ibgp = Ibgp()
ospf = Ospf()
web = WebService()

# Create Internet Exchanges with custom display names
ix1 = base.createInternetExchange(1)
ix1.setDisplayName("IX - North America")
ix2 = base.createInternetExchange(2)
ix2.setDisplayName("IX - Europe")
ix3 = base.createInternetExchange(3)
ix3.setDisplayName("IX - Asia")

# Create Transit Autonomous Systems
transit1 = base.createAutonomousSystem(100)
transit2 = base.createAutonomousSystem(200)
transit3 = base.createAutonomousSystem(300)

# Add routers to transit ASes and connect to IXes
r1 = base.createRouter(transit1, 'r1')
r2 = base.createRouter(transit2, 'r2')
r3 = base.createRouter(transit3, 'r3')
base.joinNetwork(r1, ix1)
base.joinNetwork(r2, ix2)
base.joinNetwork(r3, ix3)

# Create single-homed stub Autonomous Systems with various services
stub1 = base.createAutonomousSystem(101)
stub2 = base.createAutonomousSystem(102)
stub3 = base.createAutonomousSystem(103)

# Add routers and hosts to stub ASes
s1r = base.createRouter(stub1, 's1r')
s2r = base.createRouter(stub2, 's2r')
s3r = base.createRouter(stub3, 's3r')
base.joinNetwork(s1r, ix1)
base.joinNetwork(s2r, ix2)
base.joinNetwork(s3r, ix3)

# Add web servers to stub ASes
h1 = base.createHost(stub1, 'web1')
h2 = base.createHost(stub2, 'web2')
h3 = base.createHost(stub3, 'web3')
web.addWebService(h1, 80)
web.addWebService(h2, 80)
web.addWebService(h3, 80)

# Add a host with a customized IP address to one of the Autonomous Systems
custom_host = base.createHost(stub1, 'custom')
base.setAddress(custom_host, '10.10.10.10/24')

# Create a real-world Autonomous System
real_as = base.make_real_as(64512)
real_router = base.createRealWorldRouter(real_as, 'real-router')
base.joinNetwork(real_router, ix1)

# Enable remote access to one of the Autonomous System's network
base.enableRemoteAccess(stub2)

# Set up peering via a route server and private peering with different peer relationships
# Add a route server to IX2
rs = base.createRouter(ix2, 'rs')
ebgp.addRsPeer(rs, r2)
ebgp.addRsPeer(rs, s2r)

# Private peering between transit1 and transit2 (peer)
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(r1, r2, PeerRelationship.PEER)

# Private peering between transit1 and stub1 (customer-provider)
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(r1, s1r, PeerRelationship.PROVIDER)

# Private peering between transit3 and stub3 (provider-customer)
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(r3, s3r, PeerRelationship.CUSTOMER)

# Add all layers to the emulator
emu.addLayer(base)
emu.addLayer(routing)
emu.addLayer(ebgp)
emu.addLayer(ibgp)
emu.addLayer(ospf)
emu.addLayer(web)

# Save the emulator to a component file
emu.save('emulation-component.bin')

# Render and compile the emulator
emu.render()
emu.compile()
```
